text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1: hosted-runtime runner pod redwood-runner-11 (gpu-az3-07) hit repeated KV cache OOMs for model redwood-13b-qat. Alerts spike: kv_cache.oom_rate > 1500/min. Affected: generation requests returning 503 / truncated responses. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/3645001234

alice: acked — I'm oncall. pulling logs and current mem graph now.

bob: seen this pattern before after the continuous-batching config change last night? v2.3.4 bumped max_batch_window and prefetch heuristics.

carol: memory heatmap attached (quick paste). looks like kv_map size jumped from ~1.2GB -> 18GB for few sessions. eviction didn't keep up.

alice: copying relevant log tail:
```
[2026-03-15T03:12:11Z] kv_cache: insert session=cs-8a1f size=12.4GB total_kv=12.4GB
[2026-03-15T03:12:12Z] kv_cache: insert session=cs-9b2d size=6.8GB total_kv=19.2GB
[2026-03-15T03:12:12Z] runtime: OOM allocating 512MB (kvmap growth)
[2026-03-15T03:12:12Z] runtime: eviction loop started but thrashing, freed 0B
[2026-03-15T03:12:13Z] http: 503 returned to client session=cs-8a1f
```
carol: looks like prefetched prefixes + long prompts produced runaway context windows. continuous-batching kept sessions pinned and prefetch created huge KV entries.

dave: Customer impact — Support: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, travelly) reported ~12% failed calls in the last 30m. Working on outbound notes.

emma: noted. Can we triage quick mitigation to restore availability? Need ETA for stable rollback. Customers prefer degraded latency to 503s.

alice: mitigation plan:
- throttle prefetch: set runtime flag prefetch.enabled=false for hosted-runtime pool
- cap per-session KV to 512MB (was unlimited in rollout)
- reduce max_batch_window to 50ms from 200ms
- restart affected runner pods one-by-one to pick up config

bob: I can push the config change to the hosted control plane. patch: 
```json
{"runtime":{"prefetch":{"enabled":false},"kv_cache":{"max_per_session_bytes":536870912},"batching":{"max_window_ms":50}}}
```
then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-runner -n hosted --selector=pool=redwood-hosted`

infra-bot: deploy request created #DEPLOY-7851 by bob — awaiting approvals.

alice: performing live patch via control plane to avoid full rollout for the immediate pool. applying now.

alice: applied prefetch.enabled=false and max_per_session_bytes=536870912 to pool=hosted. hitting /metrics to confirm.

carol: metrics look promising: kv_map_total_bytes decreasing from 19GB -> ~6GB over 90s. error rate dropping.

dave: support update: acme-corp ticket 2345 — they see errors subsiding, still some truncated responses. notified customers of mitigation and postmortem follow-up.

emma: good. marking customer-impacted = yes. severity remains P1 until error rate < 1% and 95th latency < 1.5x baseline.

bob: follow-up: need hotfix to prevent future runaway when long prompts combined with prefetch and large batch windows. I propose: per-session kv cap, aggressive eviction policy for prefetched keys, and backpressure on prefetch when per-host memory > 70%.

alice: filed incident ticket INC-2026-452. I'll handoff to night oncall in 30m once steady.

infra-bot: canary rollout of config change to dedicated pool succeeded.

carol: additional logs show one pathological session: session=cs-8a1f had nested function calls and tokenized prompt length ~1.2M tokens -> produced massive KV blobs. We should add a defensive guard: reject requests with tokenized length > 200k or stream incremental prefetch.

bob: agreed. patch PR inbound: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/987 — will include unit tests and a runtime guard.

alice: current status: error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.9% over last 10m. kv_map_total_bytes trending down. rolling restarts scheduled for 12 pods to pick up config (staggered).

dave: support: notifying top 10 affected customers with timeline & mitigation. template ready.

emma: assign postmortem owner? bob volunteer?

bob: I'll own the postmortem. immediate action items:
- revert or tighten continuous-batching rollout knobs (owner: bob)
- add prefetch backpressure (owner: bob)
- add per-request tokenized-length guard + reject code path (owner: carol)
- update SLO/alert thresholds to fire earlier for kv_map growth (owner: alice)

alice: handoff to @dave (night oncall) in 28m. leaving detailed notes in INC-2026-452. Adding slack incident channel #inc-3645001234.

dave: taking over. thanks team — will monitor and escalate if anything regresses.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-452 created. Severity P1 -> decreased to P2 at 3645004700 after mitigation criteria met. Postmortem request created.

alice: closing active pager for me. I'll stay available for 30m in case of regressions. :thumbsup:

bob: quick note for runbook improvement: add a one-liner to disable prefetch per-pool + how to cap per-session kv via control plane. I will PR runbook update.

carol: capturing metrics snapshots and attaching to incident ticket.

dave: ack. I'll send customer follow-ups by EOD UTC.

emma: great job all. postmortem due in 48h.

(ends)
